collection.label: Akhmim Codex (Gospel of Peter)
collection.author_name: Gospel of Peter (2nd c. AD; Akhmim codex, 6th-9th c.)
collection.critical_edition: A. Lods, diplomatic transcription and heliogravure facsimile (1893)
collection.search_terms: gospel of peter akhmim panopolis codex panopolitanus apocrypha passion resurrection pilate herod
collection.description: The Gospel of Peter from the Akhmim codex, the only manuscript of the work, page by page in Lods's 1893 photographic plates with his line-by-line transcription and Robinson's English.

texts.title: Gospel of Peter (Akhmim codex, pages 2-10)
texts.source: Akhmim codex (P. Cair. 10759) pages 2-10 in A. Lods's heliogravure plates (1893, Internet Archive) + Lods's diplomatic transcription + English of J. Armitage Robinson (Ante-Nicene Fathers IX, public domain)
texts.description: The surviving fragment of the Gospel of Peter (trial, crucifixion, burial and resurrection of Jesus), in the Greek of the only manuscript, the Akhmim codex, each chapter linked to the photographed page that carries it.

authors.name: Gospel of Peter
authors.bio: Anonymous gospel written in the name of Simon Peter, known from early church writers and from one fragment found at Akhmim in Egypt in 1886-87.
